source_level_index_logic.frequency_to_ind: int(round(seconds * frequency)); NumPy arrays use np.round(...).astype(int)
source_level_index_logic.timed_array_overlap: start_ind = frequency.to_ind(overlap_start - self.start); duration_ind = frequency.to_ind(overlap_stop - overlap_start); selected slice is start_ind:start_ind+duration_ind
source_level_index_logic.official_mne_raw_stage: filter -> resample -> RobustScaler -> MneTimedArray.from_native; event extraction then attaches event.start as TimedArray.start
source_level_index_logic.official_event_stage_order: extend for baseline -> overlap window -> baseline mean subtraction -> crop requested window -> clamp
source_level_index_logic.gated_stage_order: direct integer sample slice -> first 10 samples baseline mean subtraction -> clamp

shared_property_audit.descriptive_note: Trial 5 has a one-sample official-vs-gated window-start difference. Trials 3, 6, and 7 select identical final 25-sample windows but the official overlap baseline contains 9 samples while gated NeuroSelect uses 10.

global_classification_basis: All four are explained by official TimedArray overlap rounding the combined event-plus-window time and then deriving baseline overlap from the snapped start, while gated NeuroSelect rounds the center and uses a fixed first-10-sample baseline.
